decisions.item_text: Every electronic action the certifying person takes while working remotely can be seen straight away by regulatory inspectors at the site where batches are approved for release.
decisions.reason: No listed requirement covers real-time visibility of the certifying person's remote electronic actions to inspectors.

decisions.item_text: Where a distributor or its agent hands an activity to a subcontractor, that subcontractor holds the proper authorisation for the activity and works to standards equal to the distributor's own.
decisions.reason: No listed requirement covers authorisation and standards of subcontractors of distribution activities.

decisions.item_text: Distribution and retail activities are supervised by staff who hold the qualifications required by national law.
decisions.reason: No listed requirement covers supervision of distribution and retail work by legally qualified staff.

decisions.item_text: Organisations that store and distribute pharmaceutical products have a fully designed, documented and properly implemented quality system that includes good storage and distribution practice, quality risk management principles and management review.
decisions.reason: No listed requirement sets out the quality system expected of storage and distribution entities.

decisions.item_text: Senior management holds final responsibility for making sure an effective quality system is set up, given enough resources, put into practice and kept up.
decisions.reason: Existing requirements do not place final responsibility for the quality system on senior management.

decisions.addendum: Good storage and distribution practices are adopted so that product quality is kept throughout the shelf life across the supply chain.
decisions.reason: It states suitable procurement, storage, distribution and delivery to appropriate recipients, and adds keeping quality across the shelf life through adopted storage and distribution practice.
Both require operations to be clearly described in written procedures.
Both require responsibilities to be clearly defined in job descriptions.
Both require all risks to be identified and effective controls put in place.
Both require processes for managing outsourced activities.
It only requires a procedure for self-inspection and quality audits, without the detailed contents listed.
Both require a quality risk management system.
Both require systems for returns, complaints and recalls.
Both require systems for changes, deviations and corrective and preventive actions.

decisions.item_text: A formally authorised quality policy is in writing and sets out the company's overall intentions and requirements for quality.
decisions.reason: No listed requirement covers a written, authorised quality policy.

decisions.item_text: The quality policy may be included in a quality manual.
decisions.reason: Placing the quality policy in a quality manual is a separate optional point not covered by any listed requirement.

decisions.item_text: The company has a suitable organisational structure, shown in an organisation chart that has been formally authorised.
decisions.reason: No listed requirement covers an appropriate organisational structure shown in an authorised chart.

decisions.item_text: The responsibilities, authority and working relationships of all staff are clearly set out.
decisions.reason: Job descriptions alone do not cover clear indication of authority and relationships between staff.

decisions.item_text: Contract acceptors are audited at regular intervals.
decisions.reason: No listed requirement requires periodic audits of contract acceptors.
It only requires self-inspections to be part of the quality system, without a schedule or regularity.

decisions.addendum: Where needed, self-inspection findings lead to corrective and preventive measures.
decisions.reason: It requires self-inspections to monitor good distribution practice and adds triggering corrective and preventive measures where needed.
Both require independent, thorough self-inspection by a designated competent person.
Both require self-inspection records with all observations and, where needed, proposed corrective measures.

decisions.addendum: Management evaluates the self-inspection report and the corrective actions taken.
decisions.reason: It requires an effective follow-up programme and adds management evaluation of the report and actions.

decisions.addendum: The schedule is set every year.
decisions.reason: It requires regular self-inspections to a schedule and fixes the schedule as annual.
Freedom from bias is the independence element of the existing requirement, without its other elements.
Appropriate knowledge and experience of team members is the competence element of the existing requirement, without its other elements.
